function.description: Update the task plan / todo list shown to the user. Call this at the start of complex multi-step tasks to lay out your plan, then update task statuses as you make progress. Each call replaces the entire plan — always send the COMPLETE list of tasks. Set the first task you're about to work on to 'in_progress', mark finished ones 'completed', and upcoming ones 'pending'.
function.name: update_plan

tasks.description: The complete list of tasks. Replaces the previous plan.

function.description: Maintain bounded decision-relevant epistemic state. Upsert observations, assumptions, hypotheses, contradictions, unknowns, or capability limits using only fresh evidence IDs exposed in the managed awareness context. Observations may support completion IDs (`task`, `goal`, or `criterion:N`). Resolve or invalidate records when evidence changes; never store reasoning or bodies.
function.name: update_awareness

function.description: Maintain bounded grounded-deliberation conclusions without private reasoning. Replace the current diagnosis with exactly two or three distinct falsifiable hypotheses, or record a supported/refuted/inconclusive hypothesis test using only fresh harness-issued evidence IDs from the managed context.
function.name: update_deliberation

function.description: Read opt-in durable knowledge recorded for this project.
function.name: recall_memory

function.description: Store one stable, reusable project fact. Do not store secrets, transient task state, or reasoning.
function.name: store_memory

function.description: Read private cross-project facts and preferences approved by the user.
function.name: recall_user_profile

function.description: Store one explicit durable user fact, preference, workflow, or environment detail across projects. Never infer sensitive traits or store secrets.
function.name: store_user_profile

function.description: Remove one exact durable fact from project or user memory.
function.name: forget_memory

function.description: Atomically apply a batch of add/remove project-memory operations against the final character budget. Removes are evaluated before adds, so a remove can free space for a subsequent add. Use this when you need to consolidate multiple facts in one call instead of fighting the budget across several turns. Each operation is {op: 'add'|'remove', entry: str}.
function.name: update_memory

function.description: Search prior conversations when the user refers to earlier work. With no arguments, browse recent sessions. Use session_id plus around_ordinal to scroll around a previous match.
function.name: session_search

function.description: List reusable project skills learned by this agent. Metadata only; use read_skill to load instructions when relevant.
function.name: list_skills

function.description: Read one learned project's SKILL.md instructions on demand.
function.name: read_skill

function.description: Create or refine a reusable project SKILL.md after a non-trivial task has passed verification. Store only concise procedures and pitfalls; never credentials, raw reasoning, transient state, or routine steps.
function.name: learn_skill

function.description: Remove one agent-learned project skill. This cannot remove user-authored .agents or .codex skills.
function.name: forget_skill

function.description: Pin, unpin, archive, or restore one agent-learned project skill. Archiving is reversible and pinned skills cannot be archived.
function.name: manage_skill

function.description: Run deterministic skill maintenance: mark skills stale after 30 idle days and archive unpinned skills after 90 idle days. Never deletes skills.
function.name: curate_skills

function.description: List project-local groups of related learned skills.
function.name: list_skill_bundles

function.description: Load every relevant learned skill in one project bundle.
function.name: read_skill_bundle

function.description: Create or delete a project-local skill bundle with permission.
function.name: manage_skill_bundle

function.description: Draft a candidate from failed traces, then stage, promote, or discard it. Proposals require compatible completed baseline and candidate benchmark reports with no quality, latency, or token-cost regression.
function.name: evolve_skill

function.description: Delegate one bounded read-only investigation or review to an independent auxiliary GLM worker. The worker cannot edit files or run commands. Use background=true to fan out work and continue without blocking — the worker runs in the background and delivers its report as a new session message when complete (Hermes v0.18 fan-out parity).
function.name: delegate_task

background.description: If true, run the worker in the background and return immediately; the report arrives as a session message when complete. Default false (blocking).

function.description: Use an installed language server for precise symbol navigation. Lines and columns are 1-based; this tool never edits files.
function.name: semantic_code

function.description: Transactionally apply validated unified-diff hunks to multiple files. Every expected_sha256 must match; all files change or none do.
function.name: apply_patch_set

function.description: Run up to 20 independent read/list/search operations concurrently and return one bounded JSON result, reducing model round trips.
function.name: batch_read

function.description: Run a bounded declarative dependency graph of ordinary tools. Stops on the first failed step; no dynamic code or generated steps.
function.name: run_workflow

function.description: List, verify, install, or manage trusted publishers for hash-pinned data-only plugin packages. Executable plugin files are rejected.
function.name: plugin_package

function.description: Run, inspect, verify, promote, or discard an implementation worker in a detached Git worktree. Promotion requires the exact reviewed diff hash.
function.name: worktree_worker

function.description: List or discard secret-safe failure drafts, or promote a reviewed draft into a project-local outcome-based benchmark case.
function.name: failure_corpus
